title: String equation for conformal loop ensemble on Liouville quantum gravity sphere
summary: Matrix models express partition functions of random surfaces with prescribed boundary lengths through string equations. We give a probabilistic realization of this structure in Liouville quantum gravity (LQG). For $γ^2\in(8/3,4)$, we construct the quantum $n$-hole sphere from a quantum disk decorated by an independent conformal loop ensemble (CLE) and compute its area Laplace transform at fixed boundary lengths.
